A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the success of popular culture is determined by the interplay of two factors: 1) a product’s ability to differentiate itself from the competition, and 2) the degree of differentiation that the market can support.
the success of popular culture is determined by the optimal positioning of products within a feature space.
the more similar a song is to the songs that surround it in the feature space, the less likely that song is to succeed in popular culture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
popular culture is not a monolithic, undifferentiated mass of sameness, but rather a dynamic and heterogeneous system of cultural products that are differentiated along a number of dimensions.
the success of cultural products depends on their positioning within feature space.
